title: LibScript TFRC Zero-Cost Policy Schema
description: Explicit user-supplied TPU Research Cloud (TFRC) quota and zero-cost guardrail policy required before any Cloud TPU provisioning.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag for the TFRC policy contract (must be '1.0').

gcp_project_id.description: Exact Google Cloud Project ID approved for the TFRC research grant.

strict_zero_cost.description: Enforces $0.00 non-TFRC GCP spend by blocking GKE, Persistent Disks, static IPs, Artifact Registry, and cross-region GCS.

forbid_gke.description: Blocks GKE cluster and XPK CPU node-pool creation (which incur non-TFRC charges).

forbid_persistent_disks.description: Blocks extra Compute Engine Persistent Disk creation and strips DISK_SIZE_GB / TPU_DATA_DISK_SIZE.

forbid_external_static_ip.description: Blocks reservation of billable static external IP addresses.

forbid_artifact_registry.description: Blocks pushing container images to billable Artifact Registry repositories.

storage_mode.description: Default artifact/code sync mode ('ssh' zero-bucket stream, or 'same_region_gcs' verified regional bucket).

allowed_gcs_buckets.description: Optional allowlist of gs:// bucket URIs permitted when storage_mode is 'same_region_gcs'.

items.description: Allowlisted Google Cloud Storage gs:// bucket URI.

max_ttl_minutes.description: Maximum time-to-live in minutes armed via the remote TPU VM dead-man's switch timer.

shm_min_free_gb.description: Minimum free /dev/shm host RAM tmpfs space in GiB before evicting completed backend virtualenvs.

grants.description: Non-empty list of TFRC zone, SKU, scheduling tier, and capacity grants.

zone.description: Approved Google Cloud zone for TFRC TPU VMs (e.g., 'us-central2-b', 'us-central1-a', 'europe-west4-a').

accelerator_types.description: Approved TPU accelerator topologies in this zone (e.g., 'v4-8', 'v4-32', 'v5litepod-8', 'v6e-8').

scheduling_tiers.description: Approved scheduling tiers for this grant ('spot', 'preemptible', or 'on-demand').

max_chips.description: Maximum total TPU chips permitted by this grant across single-host or multi-host slices.

max_hosts.description: Maximum TPU VM worker hosts permitted in a multi-host pod slice.

max_concurrent_nodes.description: Maximum concurrent TPU VM nodes or Queued Resources permitted in this zone.

expires_on.description: Optional UTC expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the TFRC grant notification email.
